@deskOvRestoreTitle.description: Overview panel title while the core's restore scan from block 0 has not finished.

deskOvRestoreRunning: Looking for this wallet's funds on the chain, from the first block. Received EPIC shows as it is found; receiving and sending open when the scan finishes.

@deskOvRestoreRunning.description: Overview panel text while the restore scan runs; a progress bar follows.

deskOvRestoreAfterHeight: Funds after block {height} are in. Earlier blocks are being checked; receiving and sending open when that finishes.

@deskOvRestoreAfterHeight.description: Overview panel text when the restore started from a block height and the earlier blocks are scanned now.

deskOvRestoreWaiting: The scan waits for the network.

@deskOvRestoreWaiting.description: Overview panel text while the restore scan cannot run (Offline mode or no node); deskNetOfflineReason may follow.

deskOvRestoreFailed: The scan stopped before the end. Receiving and sending stay closed until it finishes.

@deskOvRestoreFailed.description: Overview panel text after the restore scan failed; Try again follows.

@deskOvRestoreProgress.description: Semantics label of the progress bar in the restore panel.

deskErrRestoreScanRequired: Restore not finished. Receiving and sending open when the scan of the chain ends.

@deskErrRestoreScanRequired.description: Error for the core's RestoreScanRequired on the desktop (Receive, Send, invoices).

deskSetRescanRestoreRunning: The restore scan is running: the chain is read from the first block. Recheck balance is available when it finishes.

@deskSetRescanRestoreRunning.description: Recheck page line while the restore scan runs (replaces the generic "a scan is already running"); progress follows.

@deskSetRescanStartHeading.description: Heading of the start-choice radio group on the Recheck page.

@deskSetRescanRecent.description: Recheck start choice: from 100 blocks before the last scanned one (default).

deskSetRescanRecentHint: From 100 blocks before the last one scanned. Enough after a failed send or a balance that looks wrong.

@deskSetRescanFromHeight.description: Recheck start choice; same text as the phone's settingsRescanFromHeight.

deskSetRescanHeightInvalid: Enter a block height of 1 or more.

@deskSetRescanHeightInvalid.description: Field error for the Recheck start height; same text as the phone's settingsRescanHeightInvalid.

@deskSetRescanWholeChain.description: Recheck start choice: from block 0; same text as the phone's settingsRescanWholeChain.

deskSetRescanWholeChainHint: From the first block. Finds everything and takes long. Also finishes an unfinished restore.

@deskOnbForgotLink.description: Text link on Unlock; opens Set a new password.

@deskOnbForgotTitle.description: Side title of the forgot-password page.

deskOnbForgotLead: The recovery phrase of {name} replaces its password. History, notes and labels stay; no scan is needed.

@deskOnbForgotLead.description: Lead of the phrase step; {name} is the wallet shown on Unlock. ⚠ de "Labels": use the word the desktop tx-label feature uses in German.

deskOnbForgotPasswordLead: The phrase checks out. Choose the new password that unlocks this wallet on this computer.

@deskOnbForgotSet.description: Primary button of the password step.

deskOnbForgotOtherWallet: This phrase belongs to another wallet, not to {name}. Nothing was changed.

@deskOnbForgotOtherWallet.description: Firm error on the grid when the phrase's fingerprint is not the wallet's.

@deskOnbSameNewPassword.description: Third button of the "already here" dialog; replaces that wallet's password with this phrase.

@deskSetupSkip.description: Footer button on every Setup step; leaves Setup without saving.

deskSetupSkipKeeps: Skip keeps the node and Epicbox settings as they are.

@deskSetupSkipKeeps.description: Helper line next to Skip; deskSetupLaterNote follows it.

deskSetupMarkNotCleared: Setup could not be marked as done: {reason}. It may open again at the next start; Skip setup closes it.

@deskSetupMarkNotCleared.description: Toast after Skip or Save when neither the store nor the wallet folder could note that Setup was done; {reason} is the error without a trailing stop.

@deskOvRestoredImportTitle.description: Title of the history-backup offer after the first unlock of a restored wallet.

deskOvRestoredImportBody: The recovery phrase brought back the balance. A history backup exported from this wallet brings back its payment history, contacts, invoices and settings: the file saved outside the old computer.

@deskOvRestoredImportButton.description: Primary button; opens the Backup page's file chooser. Same text as the phone's restoreImportButton.

deskOvRestoredImportLater: Later under Settings › This wallet › Backup.

@deskOvRestoredImportLater.description: Small line under the buttons. Uses the page names deskSetFrameThisWallet and deskSetBackupGroup.

deskOnbForgotNoCheck: Nothing in this wallet's files can confirm the phrase, so the password stays.

@deskOnbForgotNoCheck.description: Forgot password: the wallet's folder holds nothing the phrase can be checked against; nothing changed.

deskOnbForgotRestoreHint: Restore it from the phrase instead: {name} leaves the list and its files stay on this computer.

@deskOnbForgotRestoreHint.description: Forgot password: the way out when the phrase cannot be checked; the button below does it.

@deskOnbForgotRestoreInstead.description: Forgot password: button when the phrase cannot be checked; removes the wallet from the list (files kept) and opens Restore with the phrase.
